svg.title: OpsPilot AWS architecture
svg.desc: Browser dashboard connects through API Gateway to an API Lambda. The API stores demo sessions and workflow state in DynamoDB and queues workflow IDs in SQS. SQS invokes a worker Lambda, which calls Bedrock Nova Micro and saves checkpoints and simulation receipts. Both functions use IAM roles and CloudWatch logging. Failed SQS deliveries go to a dead-letter queue monitored by a CloudWatch alarm. SAM and CloudFormation deploy resources using S3 code artifacts. AWS Budgets sends an email cost alert. This documents the retired demonstration deployment.

g.text: Evidence-led offboarding / human approval / simulated access changes
Human approval binds to the exact action. Execution creates a simulation receipt.
IAM and Budgets are account-level controls.
Reproducible demo architecture from template.yaml. AWS resources retired November 10, 2026.
